programmes.t: Neighbors Won't Stop Fighting
programmes.d: Rival mothers Cecilia and Elizabeth engage in a relentless feud of one-upmanship, forcing their kids, Josh and Hazel, to sneak around to date. Exposed at a school formal, the moms' rivalry unravels, revealing their mutual insecurities and paving the way for reconciliation.

programmes.t: Mom Chases Teenage Shoplifter
programmes.d: After witnessing a teen steal ramen and medicine, a woman calls the police. She later discovers the boy was caring for his sick grandmother—the same woman who saved her own mother from poverty years ago.

programmes.t: Millionaire Shames Her Poor Sibling
programmes.d: Wealthy Ali constantly belittles her modest sister Grace. After discovering her husband's infidelity and seeing her kids' ingratitude, Ali realizes that Grace's simple life holds the true meaning of family.

programmes.t: Greedy Boss Fires Staff by Using AI
programmes.d: Greedy CEO Deandre replaces his staff with AI to maximize profits. The plan backfires as he loses major clients and alienates his family, learning that human empathy cannot be automated.

programmes.t: Man Adopts Terminally Ill 10-Year-Old
programmes.d: Terminally ill Matthew is abandoned by his wife after his diagnosis. Seeking purpose, he adopts Tara, a sick orphan. Though she passes away, Matthew learns he changed her world by giving her love.

programmes.t: 20-Year-Old Cannot Pass High School
programmes.d: After his parents die, Clay struggles to balance school, work, and raising his sister. Bullies later help him graduate after learning his truth, proving you never know what someone is going through.

programmes.t: Poor Kid Wins Race With Old Broken Shoes
programmes.d: Lucky, a poor Punjabi boy, and his sister share one pair of shoes. He enters a race to win her new ones but loses to help a hurt runner. His selflessness leads to a life-changing reward for his family.

programmes.t: Teacher Faces The Toughest Class
programmes.d: Terrorists hijack Yasmine's plane, but she, a seemingly demure teacher, neutralizes them. Starting a new life teaching unruly high schoolers, Yasmine finds herself entangled in a drug operation tied to a mayoral candidate, forcing her to use her past skills to protect her students.

programmes.t: Kung Fu Master Helps Teens In School
programmes.d: Malic, a hardened teen, is trapped in a gang lifestyle by his brother. A caring teacher, Mr. Wang, uncovers Malic's past trauma and helps him find a new path, inspiring Malic to help his brother escape the cycle of violence.

programmes.t: Scrawny Teen Becomes Popular
programmes.d: Benji, a bullied teen, learns martial arts for self-defense. He uses his skills in an underground fight club for money, but guided by his master's wisdom, he chooses to fight for justice, helping his mom and a neighbor escape abusive situations.

programmes.t: Streamer Is Caught Cheating
programmes.d: Mikey scams viewers by having his brother, Jayden, play Minecraft on his stream, taking all the credit and money. His deception unravels at a fan event when he can't play himself, exposing his fraud. Jayden then gains recognition, leaving Mikey to face the consequences.

programmes.t: Employee Fakes Sick To Skip Work
programmes.d: Jacob, a compulsive liar, fakes his grandma's death to skip work for a date with his boss's daughter, Nicole. His web of lies unravels when both grandmas appear, exposing his deceit and costing him his job, his girlfriend, and his dignity.

programmes.t: Caught Cheating On Drivers Test
programmes.d: Tim, a spoiled teen, cheats on his driving test using his dad's Tesla, but his schemes unravel. After hitting a car and failing, he's arrested, and his furious dad refuses bail, leaving Tim to face the consequences alone.

programmes.t: Teen Caught Sneaking into a Party
programmes.d: Peter lies to his crush Ariel to secure a date at a sold-out concert. After giving his tickets away, he poses as the headlining DJ, leading to a viral stage disaster and losing Ariel's trust.

programmes.t: Goth Girl Accused of Being a Bad Influence
programmes.d: Lisa judges her boyfriend's goth daughter, Ruby, as a bad influence. However, Ruby proves her wrong by saving Harley from bullies and tutoring her to an A, showing character matters more than looks.

programmes.t: Guy Asks Wrong Twin to Prom
programmes.d: When a wrong locker number pairs quiet artist Tyler with popular twin Mila for prom, her sister Ava undergoes a superficial makeover to make him jealous—only for both twins to realize authenticity wins.

programmes.t: Husband Gets Arrested for Pranking Wife
programmes.d: Vloggers Owen and Michelle engage in a prank war after Michelle finds his plan to fake a police chase. With real officers' help, she stages his arrest, teaching him that karma always comes back around.

programmes.t: Girl With Perfect Health Given 1 Month to Live
programmes.d: Terminally ill fitness influencer Grace rejects painful hospital treatment to run a final marathon. Her viral journey inspires millions and leads to a life-saving 90% survival medical trial.

programmes.t: Students Must Wear Their Grades for a Week
programmes.d: Forced to wear badges of their GPAs, failing artist Isa and overachiever Brielle team up to replace public shaming with a supportive peer tutoring program.

programmes.t: Daycare Calls Child Services on Poor Mom
programmes.d: Single mom Carmen is fired for bringing her son to work at a hotel. After a daycare dispute leads to a CPS visit, the hotel's undercover owner saves her family and promotes her to manager.

programmes.t: Poor Girl Is Shamed for Cheap Gifts
programmes.d: Amy hides her poverty from her wealthy best friend, Carmen, to fit in. Rival Brandy exposes Amy's fake designer bag, but is then arrested for fraud. Amy reconciles with Carmen and finds true value.

programmes.t: Toxic Friends Don't Know Friend Is Secretly Famous
programmes.d: After being bullied for his weight and mocked for his dream of stand-up, lawyer Jonah quits his job. Guided by comedian Lauren, he finds success and proves his toxic friends and ex-girlfriend wrong.

programmes.t: Girl Is Dumped Then Becomes a Millionaire
programmes.d: After her fiancé Alex fires her and leaves her for her best friend, Hannah seeks revenge by teaming up with his estranged brother, Logan. She finds true success and love where she least expected it.

programmes.t: Poor Family Ashamed of Garbage Man Dad
programmes.d: After being framed by his partner, former CEO Kwame works as a garbage man to support his kids. He eventually exposes the partner's corruption, reclaiming his firm and teaching his kids pride.

programmes.t: Girl Bullied for Wearing Temu Clothes
programmes.d: Zoe is bullied by Skylar for wearing "cheap" Temu clothes. After discovering Skylar's own home life is toxic, Zoe uses her design talent to help them both find authenticity and red-carpet success.

programmes.t: Mom Must Go Back to Daughter's High School
programmes.d: When single mom Nia enrolls in her daughter Chloe's high school to finish her diploma for a promotion, Chloe is mortified. However, Nia's past struggles as a teen mom eventually bridge their gap.

programmes.t: Boy In Makeup Gets Bullied In New School
programmes.d: Nigel, a flamboyant track athlete, faces bullying for wearing makeup. Despite early race fumbles and sabotage, he trains hard, breaks school records, wins the finals, and secures a Nike sponsorship.

programmes.t: Rich Woman Goes Homeless For 24 Hours
programmes.d: Journalist Jennifer poses as a homeless person for 24 hours to prove it's a "choice." Facing hunger and hostility, she is saved by Renea, a woman she previously mocked. Humbled, Jennifer reunites Renea with her long-lost daughter.

programmes.t: Poor Mom Saves Disabled Homeless Teen
programmes.d: Jackie, a waitress, nearly hits Pedro, a homeless teen amputee. She takes him in, buys him a prosthetic leg, and helps him rejoin track. Pedro wins a legal settlement and repays her by clearing her debts.

programmes.t: Kid Won't Go To Sleep At Night
programmes.d: Teen Jay, refusing to follow his bedtime rules, pulls an all-nighter, only to ruin his important audition. Humiliated and exhausted, he finally learns to appreciate his mother's rules and the importance of rest.

programmes.t: Kid Steals Tickets At Fun Center
programmes.d: Teens Mikey and Jay cheat to win a video game convention pass at a birthday party. Their scheme is exposed, but not before their moms overhear, resulting in both boys being punished and learning a hard lesson.

programmes.t: Kids Build Secret Gaming Room To Hide From Mom
programmes.d: Jay tricks his mom into taking a vacation so he can build a secret gaming room. His plan succeeds until his mom's early return exposes his lies, leading to a hilarious punishment that teaches him a valuable lesson in honesty.

programmes.t: Kids Cheat Mrbeast For $1 Million
programmes.d: Dhar Mann challenges fans to meet MrBeast for $1M. Mikey and Jay cheat through the games but get busted, leaving honest Derek to win. The sore losers go out with a bang, ruining the finale by pieing MrBeast and Jay Shetty in front of everyone.

programmes.t: Kid Completes 100 Dares In 24 Hours
programmes.d: After accepting a $100 dare, Nathan completes 100 gross and embarrassing challenges set by Colin. When Nathan finishes, Colin admits he never had the money. Bruno, whom Nathan dared to mess with, confronts Colin, who runs off, and Omar buys the Airpods Nathan took as "payback" for the $100.

programmes.t: Kid Chooses Cool Guys Over Friends
programmes.d: Middle schooler Jay, hoping to impress his cousin Tiffany, ditches his friends to play basketball with high schoolers who only want him to get close to Tiffany. Jay's friends expose the truth, leading to an epic basketball showdown.

programmes.t: Girl Can't See Family on Thanksgiving
programmes.d: After job loss and a grounded flight ruin her Puerto Rican Thanksgiving plans, Analeese launches a DIY business with friends' help. They surprise her with a home-cooked feast and family FaceTime.

programmes.t: Poor Sisters Not Allowed To Eat
programmes.d: The sudden death of their mother leaves Laura and Ana and their father, Miguel, struggling with grief and poverty. For Thanksgiving, the girls secretly salvage their dad's ruined dinner, reminding him that family makes it work, catching the attention of a wealthy party host.

programmes.d: When teen Sophie gets a phone, her popular friends secretly film her private life for a paid reality show. After discovering their secret cameras, she exposes their betrayal in court.

programmes.d: After being kicked out for his dedication to acting, Alex disguises himself as a nanny to be near his kids. He must then contend with his wife's new boyfriend and the challenges of being a nanny. When his cover is blown, he must decide between his career and his family.

programmes.t: Teen Caught Cheating By Live Audience
programmes.d: Aspiring gamer Jordan resorts to cheating, using aimbots to win a Call of Duty tournament and impress his crush. His deceit unravels during the finals when his cheat fails, exposing his lies and leading to public humiliation.

programmes.t: Adult Wants To Stay Adult Forever
programmes.d: Child actor Brent, unwilling to age out of his famous role, faces rejection in Hollywood. Broke and desperate, he takes a diner job, where a chance encounter with his childhood idol inspires him to embrace maturity and pursue new acting dreams.

programmes.t: Birthday Party Changes Girl's Life Forever
programmes.d: Envious magician Marvin sabotages rival Princess Wanda's party, only to find himself unexpectedly filling in as her unicorn sidekick. Their accidental collaboration leads to unforeseen success, forcing them to embrace teamwork and a new magical partnership.

programmes.t: Kid Builds Waterpark In House
programmes.d: Jay plans an epic waterpark party for Gretchen's birthday to impress her, but it gets busted by the cops. Despite the chaos, Gretchen is touched by his thoughtfulness, and they become a couple, much to their parents' amusement.

programmes.t: Overlooked Little Person Becomes Fashion Star
programmes.d: After her sister Madison claims she'll never model, Aria, a woman with dwarfism, lands a major casting call. Despite industry cruelty, she proves her talent, earns her sister's support, and shines.

programmes.t: Homeless Teen Wins $1 Million in Game Show
programmes.d: After his guardian locks him away to help a rival win, homeless teen Samir escapes to compete in a game show. Using his father's wisdom, he wins $1M and reunites with his dad while his abuser is jailed.

programmes.t: Student Takes IQ Serum To Impress Girl
programmes.d: Chad, a lazy law student, uses a "genius serum" to ace exams and impress a girl. When the serum's effects fade, he faces academic and financial ruin, forcing him to abandon shortcuts and embrace hard work, ultimately finding true success.

programmes.t: Students Face The World's Toughest Exam
programmes.d: In a dystopian future where failed exams mean execution, Carson, the Governor's son, discovers the system is rigged. With his genius friend Maya and a tenacious journalist, he exposes the corruption, fighting to save his loved ones and ignite a revolution.

programmes.d: Mikey disguises himself as his dad to steal his college fund for an Apple Vision Pro. His mom stages a fake arrest to teach him that bad choices always lead to even worse consequences.
